scope: Uninterrupted writing, voice previews, virtual cursor dialogs and spoken onboarding.

topics.title: Spoken getting-started and browser lessons
details: Say Start tutorial. Choose Getting started or Web browser with voice or arrows and Enter. Lessons wait for Next lesson or Enter, support Previous lesson and Repeat, and do not send real messages or create files.

topics.title: Voice settings previews
details: Options demonstrate staged voice, rate, pitch and volume before saving. Escape cancels changes. SAPI and eSpeak previews use the staged settings; AI previews require a saved key and enabled permission.

topics.title: Word processor writing and naming
details: Ordinary dictated document text is added silently. Explicit Read document remains available. Empty document-name entry accepts letters and editing keys without triggering menu actions.

topics.title: Feedback and background behavior
details: App narration is excluded from ordinary recognition across synthesizers. Stop, sleep, exit and browser controls remain available. The cloud recognizer keeps its connection during feedback pauses. Dynamic virtual-view updates no longer force keyboard focus or raise the app.

topics.title: Webpage navigation and dialogs
details: Page links, headings and fields no longer include menu letter labels. Quick navigation remains available. Visible modal dialogs scope the virtual cursor to their content. JavaScript links can complete without changing URLs, avoiding an unnecessary eight-second wait. Website alerts are announced, and website confirmation dialogs are canceled automatically rather than accepted.

topics.title: Consumer testing
details: Added regression checks for naming, silent dictation, staged previews, tutorial navigation and contact dialogs. Expanded the read-only live audit to Control Alt Success home, services, training, assessment, custom training, resources, blog and the public portal page. Live contact messages are not sent.
